provenance.methodNote: Each entry is the verbatim trait_data.inc row of a SPECIALIZATION-tree (tree_index 2) trait of class 11 whose id_spec names 105, read at the pinned commit; field order is trait_data.hpp's trait_data_t. Which of the spec's traits are healing cooldowns is a hand-reviewed selection, recorded per entry; nothing else about the spells (cooldown, charges, duration, effect) is claimed here. Since HEAL-B1 the cast id is the row's id_override_spell when it has one (trait_data.hpp: 'id_spell is overriden by id_override_spell for display/activation in-game'), and id_spell otherwise.
provenance.applicabilityNote: Not version-gated at runtime, for the same reason as the other pinned datasets: CombatFight exposes no client-build key. The build is recorded for traceability.

healingCooldowns.selectionNote: The spec's channelled raid-wide healing cooldown. A use is the completed cast event; the channel's own ticks are not separate uses. Not observed in any committed evidence; identified from the pinned row only.
